description: Check income eligibility thresholds (extremely low, very low, low-income) for HUD programs by area and family size. Returns income limits by category. Use to determine program qualification.

entity_id.description: FIPS code or metro area code for a specific area. Omit to get all areas in the state.

year.description: Fiscal year (e.g., 2024). Omit for the most recent year.

name: hud_income_limits
